shots.focal_element: Giant virtual cloud-gaming screen (Xbox Game Pass shooter gameplay) floating in a living room, viewed over the shoulder of a headset wearer on the left
on_screen_text: Requires Xbox Game Pass Ultimate subscription and supported controller (sold separately). Streaming limitations apply; server availability and wait times may vary. Select regions.
shots.typography: In-screen partner logo 'GAME PASS' in bold uppercase sans with Xbox glyph (part of the game UI); legal disclaimer in small regular-weight sentence-case sans, centered in two lines at the bottom, neutral tracking (font guess, low confidence: Meta's Optimistic Text).
shots.what_happens: Over-the-shoulder shot of a man in a Quest 3 watching a huge angled virtual screen playing a third-person shooter while a legal disclaimer sits at the bottom; the last sampled frame (1:32.0) is already washed in warm red light leading into the next shot.
shots.build_rebuild: Composite a perspective-warped gameplay video plane onto live-action room footage with a soft-edge mask, keep the wearer in the left third, and overlay a two-line centered 14px disclaimer at the bottom for the full shot duration.

shots.focal_element: First-person mixed-reality living room with a reaching hand and a blurred virtual creature, then a third-person view of a wearer holding a tentacled creature
shots.transition_other: Warm red-orange light-leak wash that floods the previous frame before resolving into the passthrough living room
shots.what_happens: POV passthrough view of a cosy living room as the user's arm swings toward a motion-blurred virtual creature; within the same shot id the image cuts to a third-person view of a young person in the headset holding up a dark tentacled creature, as the lyric 'I'm all about the hype' (w66-w67) begins.
shots.build_rebuild: Cross a full-frame red-orange radial light-leak overlay (opacity 0 to 0.8 and back over ~8 frames) on the cut into POV footage, then hard-cut to the third-person reverse angle on the next music beat.

shots.focal_element: Glowing orange mixed-reality portal with root-like tentacles breaking through the wall above a fireplace, a blurred hand in the foreground
shots.what_happens: A half-second POV beat: the user's hand sweeps across frame (heavy motion blur) in front of a virtual molten portal anchored to the real wall, tentacles creeping onto the ceiling, timed to lyric words w67-w68.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut on the beat to a 13-frame POV clip of a 3D portal tracked onto the wall, adding directional motion blur to the foreground hand and an additive orange glow behind the portal mask.

shots.focal_element: Bold white 'Get ready' caption centered over a woman in a Quest 3 swinging her controllers
shots.typography: Bold rounded geometric sans, sentence case, white, centered mid-frame, slightly tight tracking, no box or shadow visible (font guess, low confidence: Meta Optimistic Display).
shots.what_happens: Opens on a POV hand touching the glowing wall portal, then cuts to a woman in a bright room throwing a punch with her controllers while 'Get ready' sits centered; the keyframe shows a white light-streak swoosh sweeping across her, as the lyric resolves on 'hype!' (w69-w70).
shots.build_rebuild: Cut from the portal POV clip to the fitness clip on the beat, fade in a centered bold white two-word caption, and sweep a soft white additive light-trail sprite horizontally across the subject in ~10 frames.

shots.shot_type_other: Fast montage alternating captured-on-PC game footage and live-action lifestyle footage with kinetic caption words (several internal cuts inside one shot id)
shots.focal_element: Centered caption phrase split across clips ('to expand' / 'your world') over headset wearers, intercut with VR game captures
shots.typography: Caption words in bold rounded geometric sans, all lowercase, white, large and centered, tight tracking; 'Captured on PC.' disclaimer in small regular sentence-case sans at bottom center of each game capture (font guess, low confidence: Meta Optimistic).
shots.what_happens: Beat-cut montage: a VR painting game (canvas on an easel by a lake), a man in a sunlit room swinging a controller with 'to expand', a VR tennis/pickleball game on a beach court, a man in a dark blue room in boxing stance with 'your world', and a cartoon VR boxing opponent with a flaming glove; the caption completes the line 'Get ready to expand your world' across shots.
shots.build_rebuild: Cut five ~0.75s clips on successive music beats, alternating game capture (with a bottom-center 'Captured on PC.' label) and lifestyle footage, and place one centered lowercase bold caption phrase on each lifestyle clip with a quick opacity fade-in.

shots.focal_element: Close-up of a hand with rings adjusting the front of a Quest 3 headset on the wearer's face
shots.what_happens: A half-second shallow-depth-of-field close-up of the wearer lifting or adjusting the headset against a warm window-lit background, a quick product-in-hand beat after the montage.
shots.build_rebuild: Hard-cut to a 12-frame shallow-focus close-up of the headset in hand on the next beat, with no text overlay.
